generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent 2D game weapon sprite for Don't Starve Together.
Reference image: the approved Wili concept sheet. Copy the weapon silhouette HELD BY THE LARGE LEFT CHARACTER, not the standalone knife on the right, because the left character's blade direction was explicitly corrected and approved by the user.
Primary request: isolate and redraw that exact silver moon curved short blade as a high quality, clean readable transparent sprite. No character, no hand, no text. One weapon only.
Orientation: vertical knife, lunar pommel at the very top, black/navy wrapped handle next, small moon-crescent guard with sapphire blue jewel below the handle, blade BELOW the guard. Broad silver blade descends almost straight down, bows a little LEFT at its middle, then sweeps to a needle-sharp point toward the LOWER RIGHT. The bright silver cutting bevel is on the outer LEFT convex edge; the darker steel inner spine is on the RIGHT concave side. This is the main character's knife in the reference, NOT the right-hand display weapon mirrored the other way. Reverse-grip pose will be added in game by placing the HAND around the existing handle; do not draw a hand.
Keep the full knife about 3.3 times as tall as wide. Blade length from guard to tip about 65% of total weapon height. Keep a broad recognizable silver curved blade, not a thin straight dagger. Simple sturdy little moon guard, deep sapphire blue hexagonal jewel, navy-black wrapped leather grip, silver crescent pommel. Thick near-black ink outline, hand-painted angular silver highlights and dark steel shadows in Don't Starve 2D aesthetic. Detailed enough at large size but simple readable silhouette at 64-pixel icon size. No glow, no sparkles, no magical trails, no drop shadow, no ground.
Transparent background with actual alpha; entire object visible with generous clean empty padding. Preserve reference design and colours.
cleanup_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this single silver crescent knife on transparent background.
Change only the alpha background: remove every bit of outer gray haze, glow, fog, drop shadow, cast shadow and background pixels outside the black ink contour. Render the weapon as an opaque crisp 2D game sprite, with fully solid opaque weapon interiors and genuine fully transparent empty space outside the outline. The output must be a cutout sprite with NO fuzzy aura. Normal antialiasing only in a 1-2 pixel narrow edge is fine.
Keep the entire knife geometry, tip pointing lower right, guard, sapphire, black/navy wrapped handle, crescent pommel, silver coloring, exact proportions and all internal details unchanged. Do not redesign, rotate, crop, mirror, elongate, shorten, or change any weapon shape. No additional objects.
